title: Göbekli Tepe chalices and burial rituals

tellings.quote: But Brian also mentions archaeologically excavated chalices at Göbekli Tepe, which dates back 12,000 years ago, right before the agrarian revolution.

plain: Chalices have been dug up at Göbekli Tepe, an ancient stone site about 12,000 years old, from just before people took up farming, and they are tied to burial rituals there. Michels takes this from the writer Brian Muraresku's book The Immortality Key in an episode about mushrooms. The idea is that ritual drinks, possibly mind-altering ones, may go back to the very start of civilisation.
